answer: The tundra escrow is released only against a timber receipt, and the plume audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 31 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 47 aliases means carrying 32 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
